item.title: Gone
item.description: The signs were unmistakable. Within a month, our once frequent, daily interactions dwindled to sporadic and strained exchanges, leaving me to vie for the privilege of a FaceTime glimpse of my son. Her reluctance was palpable, replacing our routine calls and texts with silence or annoyance. Heads up: If you’ve been victimized by a partner’s deceit and then further by the gaslighting that ensued, I acknowledge you. You understand the unfolding script.

item.title: Struck by Lightning
item.description: Deconstructing Disinformation In early July of this year Sam confessed that God had spoken to her. His message—a lightning bolt that cleaved a tree—was God’s edict for her return to me, underscoring my role as the provider for her and our son. This portent also heralded the arrival of our daughter, destined for a Messianic role. Curiously, this revelation glossed over her and our son’s whereabouts during the previous year’s absence.

item.title: Fickle Foundations
item.description: She is Always On-Message; Never Backing Down; Refusing to Concede a Single Thing. According to Sam, my feelings were invalidated by her superseding prerogative as a creator to go to that photoshoot. It was just her way of “giving something back to the community”

item.title: Shadow and Silence
item.description: A Look Through the Filtered Lens She waxed lyrical about an upcoming photoshoot, and alarm bells rang faint but clear in my head. There’s a breed of guys clutching secondhand Canon EOS cameras who fancy themselves the next Annie Leibovitz. They spin yarns about artistic enlightenment to coax women into “just-for-fun” photoshoots at home—camouflaged come-ons, if ever there were. When I voiced my qualms, she pacified me with assurances as thin as tracing paper.

item.title: About
item.description: From these quiet margins, I narrate a deeply personal story—my love-turned-entanglement with an ex-partner, the mother of my beloved two-year-old boy. “Deceit and Disease” is not an exercise in rhetoric. It is my confessional of intimate betrayals, a chronicle of emotional warfare, and a father’s struggle to reconnect with his son. Ahead lies a difficult journey. This is my sanctum, a refuge where I lay bare the wounds inflicted by a partner whose campaign of invalidation, and eventual marginalization eradicated my sense of self-worth.
